name: head
description: Print the first lines of files

name: -c
--bytes
options.description: Print the first NUM bytes of each file

name: -n
--lines
options.description: Print the first NUM lines instead of the first 10

name: -q
--quiet
options.description: Never print headers giving file names [aliases: --silent]

name: -v
--verbose
options.description: Always print headers giving file names

name: -z
--zero-terminated
options.description: Line delimiter is NUL, not newline
